THE ACTUAL SHELF · SEARCH, STYLE, COPY
Every resource is here because it does a job: a

the file. No account gates and no samples that turn
4,373 symbols in 24 styles, drawn on one grid. Search
by name, filter by style, copy SVG or PNG.
Three families with the weights and italics already
cut: a display serif, a text serif and a working
Compress a photo without uploading it. Preview the
file, keep the original and save the copy you meant
THE SAME SHELF, IN YOUR POCKET
The app works with the Wi-Fi off.
Icons, fonts and compression live on the phone. No
account, no queue, no upload. Compressed copies go
to Pictures; originals stay exactly where they were.
